SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password_hash, u.display_name, u.enabled, u.created_at, u.updated_at, u.deleted, u.version FROM sys_user u
u.deleted = 0
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.username}, '%')
AND u.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.displayName}, '%')
AND u.enabled = #{q.enabled}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.code = #{q.roleCode} AND r.deleted = 0 )
ORDER BY u.id DESC
